title: Goa Beach Escape
subtitle: Flights not included
description: Relax on golden beaches, enjoy vibrant nightlife, and savor Goan seafood in coastal Portuguese courtyards.
highlights: Private Beach Cabana & Sunset Catamaran Cruise
Old Goa UNESCO Basilica of Bom Jesus Tour
Authentic Goan Seafood Tasting & Spice Plantation Lunch
Mandovi River Evening Musical Cruise

itinerary.title: North Goa Arrival & Sunset Leisure
itinerary.desc: Chauffeur pickup from airport or station. Check-in to boutique beachfront resort, followed by welcome cocktails and a golden hour beach stroll.

itinerary.title: Old Goa Heritage & Fontainhas Latin Quarter
itinerary.desc: Guided slow walk through UNESCO Basilica of Bom Jesus and pastel Portuguese villas in Panaji. Afternoon spice plantation lunch.

itinerary.title: Palolem Coconut Shores & Sunset Catamaran Sail
itinerary.desc: Scenic morning drive south to peaceful Palolem Beach. Private catamaran sail across the Arabian Sea with dolphin sightings.

itinerary.title: Anjuna Artisan Bazaars & Departure Transfer
itinerary.desc: Explore bohemian flea markets for cashews, feni, and handcrafted souvenirs before seamless airport drop-off.

title: Kashmir Paradise Tour
subtitle: Breakfast included
description: Snow-capped mountains, serene lakes, and colorful gardens await you in Kashmir with private Dal Lake houseboats.
highlights: Private Cedar Wood Houseboat Stay on Dal Lake
Gulmarg Gondola Phase 2 Cable Car Ride (13,780 ft)
Betaab Valley & Aru Valley Chauffeur Excursion
Mughal Gardens Nishat & Shalimar Royal Walk

itinerary.title: Srinagar Arrival & Romantic Dal Lake Shikara
itinerary.desc: Chauffeur reception and transfer to luxury carved cedarwood houseboat. Sunset Shikara ride watching reflections over Char Chinar.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Apharwat Peak Gondola Snow Expedition
itinerary.desc: Ascend on the high-altitude cable car to snow-covered Apharwat Peak with panoramic vistas of the Pir Panjal range.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Valley & Saffron Fields of Pampore
itinerary.desc: Drive through fragrant purple saffron fields to the Valley of Shepherds, checking into a boutique riverside pine lodge.

itinerary.title: Betaab Valley & Aru Mountain Streams
itinerary.desc: Explore pristine Betaab Valley where classic cinema was filmed. Gentle forest pony trail through Baisaran 'Mini Switzerland'.

itinerary.title: Mughal Terraced Gardens & Pashmina Artisans
itinerary.desc: Walk royal fountains at Nishat and Shalimar Bagh. Afternoon studio visit to Master Pashmina and Walnut Wood craftsmen.

itinerary.title: Floating Market Dawn & Airport Departure
itinerary.desc: Sunrise Shikara glide through Dal Lake's 150-year-old floating flower and vegetable market, followed by airport transfer.

title: Jaipur Heritage Getaway
subtitle: City tour included
description: Explore majestic forts, colorful bazaars, and rich Rajasthani culture in the historic Pink City.
highlights: Private Amber Fort Jeep Ride & Sound/Light Show
Hawa Mahal & City Palace Royal Quarters Walk
Traditional Rajasthani Thali Dining at Chokhi Dhani
Johari Bazaar Gemstone & Block Print Shopping

itinerary.title: Jaipur Welcome, Jal Mahal & Chokhi Dhani Cultural Feast
itinerary.desc: Garland welcome and private haveli check-in. Photo-stop at water palace of Jal Mahal and authentic cultural thali night.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort Ramparts & Nahargarh Sunset Vista
itinerary.desc: Jeep ascent to Amber Fort's Sheesh Mahal hall of mirrors. Tour Maharaja's City Palace and enjoy panoramic sunset tea.

itinerary.title: Hawa Mahal Golden Hour & Johari Bazaar Treasures
itinerary.desc: Morning golden-hour shoot at Hawa Mahal façade. Guided shopping for handcrafted blue pottery and block prints.

title: Leh-Ladakh Adventure
subtitle: Bike optional
description: Experience rugged landscapes, high-altitude passes, and crystal-clear lakes on the rooftop of the world.
highlights: Cross Khardung La (18,380 ft) - World's Highest Motorable Pass
Double-Humped Bactrian Camel Safari in Hunder Sand Dunes
Stargazing Glamping at Blue Pangong Tso Lake
Thiksey Monastery Morning Prayer Chants & Magnetic Hill

itinerary.title: Leh Arrival & Rest for High-Altitude Acclimatization
itinerary.desc: Arrive at 11,500 ft. Transfer to boutique heated hotel. Dedicated day for gentle hydration and oxygen acclimatization.

itinerary.title: Shanti Stupa, Leh Royal Palace & Hall of Fame
itinerary.desc: Panoramic vistas of the Indus Valley from Shanti Stupa. Walk the ancient corridors of Leh Palace and Tibetan bazaar.

itinerary.title: Over Khardung La Pass (18,380 ft) to Nubra Valley
itinerary.desc: Exhilarating drive over one of the highest motorable passes on Earth into the lush oasis of Nubra and Diskit Monastery.

itinerary.title: Hunder White Dunes & Double-Humped Camel Safari
itinerary.desc: Ride unique double-humped Bactrian camels across cold mountain sand dunes. Excursion to border village of Turtuk.

itinerary.title: Shyok River Route to Blue Pangong Tso Lake Glamping
itinerary.desc: Dramatic road journey following the turquoise Shyok River to Pangong Tso (14,270 ft). Stargazing by the lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong Dawn Glow & Return Over Chang La Pass
itinerary.desc: Watch the morning sun turn the lake deep azure. Scenic pass crossing at Chang La and return to Leh for farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Farewell Leh & Airport Departure Transfer
itinerary.desc: Final apricot jam and prayer flag purchases before private chauffeur transfer to Kushok Bakula Airport.

title: Kerala Backwater Cruise
subtitle: Private houseboat stay
description: Sail through serene lagoons and witness Kerala's lush green beauty on a luxury private Kettuvallam.
highlights: Exclusive Private Kettuvallam Houseboat with Personal Chef
Munnar Rolling Tea Gardens & Mattupetty Dam
Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary Boat Cruise in Thekkady
Ayurvedic Herbal Rejuvenation Massage Session

itinerary.title: Kochi Arrival & Waterfall Drive to Munnar Tea Hills
itinerary.desc: Scenic drive through Cheeyappara waterfalls to mist-covered Munnar. Check-in to plantation bungalow.

itinerary.title: Eravikulam National Park & Tata Tea Museum
itinerary.desc: Spot the rare Nilgiri Tahr mountain goats in the misty grasslands. Tasting session of orthodox highland teas.

itinerary.title: Cardamom Hills & Thekkady Spice Plantation Walk
itinerary.desc: Aromatic guided walk through organic pepper, cinnamon, and vanilla farms. Evening Kathakali dance recital.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat Boarding on Vembanad Lake
itinerary.desc: Embark on an air-conditioned luxury wooden houseboat. Savor freshly caught Karimeen fish prepared by personal chef.

itinerary.title: Dawn Backwater Serenade & Kochi Airport Transfer
itinerary.desc: Fresh appam and stew breakfast while gliding past coir makers. Disembark and transfer to Kochi Airport.

title: Andaman Island Escape
subtitle: Snorkeling included
description: Turquoise waters, coral reefs, and white sandy beaches await in Andaman with high-speed catamaran island hopping.
highlights: Sunset at Asia's Best Beach — Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7)
Guided Snorkeling & Coral Reef Exploration at Elephant Beach
High-Speed Luxury Catamaran Ferry (Makruzz / Nautika)
Cellular Jail National Memorial & Sound and Light Show

itinerary.title: Port Blair Arrival & Cellular Jail Memorial
itinerary.desc: Chauffeur reception at Port Blair. Tour the historic Cellular Jail followed by the evening light and sound chronicle.

itinerary.title: Luxury Catamaran to Havelock & Radhanagar Sunset
itinerary.desc: Cruise across turquoise waters on a luxury catamaran. Afternoon on the powder-soft white sand of Radhanagar Beach.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Speedboat & Guided Coral Snorkel
itinerary.desc: Speedboat into crystal reef waters. Certified divemaster guided snorkeling over colorful living brain corals and clownfish.

itinerary.title: Neil Island Natural Bridge & Port Blair Return
itinerary.desc: Morning ferry to Neil Island. Walk the natural limestone coral bridge and Bharatpur beach before return ferry to Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Seashell Bazaars & Airport Farewell
itinerary.desc: Morning handicraft souvenir shopping at Sagarika Cottage Emporium before private airport departure transfer.

title: Golden Triangle Tour
subtitle: Cultural highlights
description: Discover Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur — the majestic heart of India's royal history and architecture.
highlights: Sunrise View of the Iconic Taj Mahal in Agra
Agra Fort & Fatehpur Sikri Red Sandstone Palaces
Amber Fort Elephant/Jeep Ascent & Hawa Mahal in Jaipur
Old Delhi Rickshaw Ride through Chandni Chowk & Qutub Minar

itinerary.title: Delhi Arrival & Imperial Architectural Landmarks
itinerary.desc: Chauffeur reception. Guided walk at UNESCO Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb, and drive along India Gate ceremonial boulevard.

itinerary.title: Old Delhi Rickshaw & Yamuna Expressway to Agra
itinerary.desc: Cycle rickshaw tour through Chandni Chowk spice markets. Afternoon express highway drive to Mughal Agra.

itinerary.title: Dawn Sunrise at Taj Mahal & Fatehpur Sikri Palaces
itinerary.desc: Witness ethereal golden dawn light on the white marble dome of the Taj Mahal. Explore red sandstone Fatehpur Sikri en route to Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort Hilltop Jeep & City Palace Museums
itinerary.desc: Ascend Amber Fort's battlements by 4x4 Jeep. Tour the Maharaja's private City Palace armory and astronomical observatory.

itinerary.title: Hawa Mahal Façade & Sunset High at Nahargarh
itinerary.desc: Morning golden-hour shoot at Hawa Mahal. Panoramic sunset tea at Nahargarh Fort overlooking the Pink City.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Delhi Scenic Highway Transfer
itinerary.desc: Morning relaxation before comfortable private chauffeur drive back to Delhi Airport for onward travels.
